issues.description: The problem statement asks students to implement assembleBookstore(verbose: Bool) (a function that accepts a Bool parameter), but the template's commented function and the provided solution both define assembleBookstore() with no parameters. This mismatch between the specified signature and the template/solution will confuse students about the correct function signature to implement and may cause test/signature mismatch issues.
issues.suggested_fix: Make the function signature consistent across artifacts. Either (A) update the problem statement to require assembleBookstore() without parameters (matching the template and solution), or (B) update the template and solution to declare assembleBookstore(verbose: Bool) and adjust calls (e.g. have Client.main() call assembleBookstore(verbose: false) or provide a default value). Choose the option that best preserves the intended exercise (if the verbose parameter was meant for optional console output, adding verbose: Bool with a default value false is a safe fix).
